name: Ice cream cone
summary: Waffle cone with one to three colourful ice cream scoops, for summer, dessert and sweets scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cone tip rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~380 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: color
params.note: colour of the bottom scoop; the others vary (chocolate, mint, vanilla)

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
